# Project Skills

Copilot, Codex and Claude Code discover skills in different directories. This repository keeps
one copy of each project skill and no forwarding adapters.

| Location | Read by | Holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.github/skills/` | Copilot (first) | OpenSpec's Copilot copies, the `drawio` skill, and project overlays or resources without a `SKILL.md` (`lsheng2-coding`, `lsheng2-ui-design`, the retained DAG project profile) |
| `.agents/skills/` | Copilot (after `.github/skills/`), Codex | Project skills such as `r2-change-loop` and `web-design-guidelines`, the Codex-only role adapters, OpenSpec's Codex copies |
| `.claude/skills/` | Claude Code | Byte-identical copies of `.agents/skills/` entries, checked by `scripts/tests/test_skill_copies.py` |

## Rules

- Shared cross-repository skills live once in the user-level `~/.agents/skills/`, which Copilot and
  Codex both read. Install them with `npx skills add <source> -g` pinned to a tag or commit. Do not
  add a project `SKILL.md` or script wrapper that forwards to a personal skill path.
- Each tool resolves one skill name to one file. A name may appear in more than one project
  directory only as a byte-identical `.claude/skills/` copy, an OpenSpec-managed per-tool copy
  (regenerated by `openspec update`, never edited by hand), or the `drawio` Codex adapter in
  `.agents/skills/` that points at `.github/skills/drawio/`.
- `.github/copilot/settings.json` turns off, for Copilot in this repository only, the Codex role
  adapters, the skills that the lanes in `AI_CONTRACT.md` §1 replace, and the Superpowers plugin
  with its SessionStart hook. The Superpowers method skills come from pinned copies in
  `~/.agents/skills/`.
- Do not run `sync_agent_adapters.py --mode sync` from the user-level DAG planning skill in this
  repository: it recreates the retired forwarding adapters.
